summary: Phase 7 implementation is complete and correct. All 215 tests pass (66 new). ExperimentTracker and ModelRegistry follow project patterns (dataclasses, PROJECT_ROOT, sequential IDs, JSON persistence). Stage transitions are enforced. Training integration is properly guarded with try/except so tracking failures never crash training. No ROS dependencies in forge_core/. No external ML tracking dependencies. All acceptance criteria for FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 are met.
